Full summary: Fixed the CI plugin-token-budget failure: rescoped the metric to context-loaded files (skills+agents) with the original v1.4 baseline preserved, and compressed the npx warning in the session-start hook. Plugin 1.11.2 → 1.11.3.
Decisions: [object Object]
Findings: The npx warning payload in session-start-context.sh was also compressed (hook 3401 → ~2450 bytes) — worth keeping regardless of the metric since the warning text IS emitted context when triggered.
